preferred_minimum_architecture.choice: Keep one stdlib-only immutable consumer plan inside existing standalone tools/release/transport.py; producer consumes it one-way. No new registry, consumer namespace, source graph, or reflection over reports.
preferred_minimum_architecture.rationale: release.yml:121 and249 extract exactly one versioned transport.py via git show into RUNNER_TEMP. Defining its pure data/API there preserves that standalone closure and separate builder/source identity, while avoiding additional extracted modules or hidden cwd imports. The module already ships by default because SDK selects tools/ recursively.
preferred_minimum_architecture.authority: Move base tuples, reviewed modern family/backend tuples and SELECTED_CONSUMERS tuples into this single source definition. Provide pure tuple-returning projections for exact source-root/git-root/build/image paths and selected assembly/smoke inputs. No IO, subprocess, filesystem discovery or producer import in plan construction. Producer reuses those records in all three main loops; existing SELECTED_CONSUMERS may remain a compatibility alias to the imported tuple, not another list.
preferred_minimum_architecture.transport_dependency_direction: Producer inserts repository/installed SDK root already; it can import tools.release.transport from its own verified source. Transport never imports verify_consumers or loads a raw-output-supplied module. Its git-show standalone pack/verify/attach entry remains self-contained apart from existing explicit source policy loading in attach.
preferred_minimum_architecture.producer_dependency_closure: Add tools/release/transport.py to package_source_sdk.py REQUIRED_FILES. Merely being exported by default is insufficient: deleting this newly necessary module and rehashing SDK manifest must still fail verification as incomplete.
preferred_minimum_architecture.strict_policy: Current pack uses a fixed reviewed plan ID and schema2 manifest, computes expected roots/images from trusted code, and requires exact roots plus every expected image path with nonzero original identity. Any report or manifest root/image list is only a claim checked against this plan and actual raw/archive inventory, never an authorization source. Exact selected records/assembly names remain checked; same-count replacement is rejected.
preferred_minimum_architecture.image_boundary: Base Native C/C++ executables have no .elf suffix; STM32/GD32 C/C++ do. Modern roots use installed_modern.elf; selected Native time pair/empty use installed_selected without suffix and other selected roots use installed_selected.elf. Do not count .bin/.map as more executable images. All expected paths must be regular nonempty originals retained in full raw inventory; transport does not replace actual compile/runtime/resource/retention checks.
preferred_minimum_architecture.source_identity_boundary: Keep original source_revision/source_tree and raw command logs unmodified. Expected commit remains explicit; builder commit/workflow/run/attempt/helper identity remain distinct. A matrix ID proves neither clean checkout nor execution; actual workflow/job identities and source-SDK verifier remain authoritative for those facts.
preferred_minimum_architecture.tradeoff: The data belongs conceptually to SDK qualification, although stored in transport to retain the existing single-file builder contract. A future separate pure module would be reasonable only with an explicitly bound multi-file standalone extraction closure and required SDK payload, not an opportunistic sibling import in this patch.

gzip_crc_followup.confirmed_source_fact: Current verify consumes tarfile.open(...r:gz) member iteration and does not explicitly drain the gzip stream to EOF/trailer. Existing test_release.py lacks CRC-only/truncated-trailer cases. This analysis executed no exploit/regression, so it does not assert that a particular archive layout was admitted incorrectly.
gzip_crc_followup.test: Fresh pack fixture, corrupt only gzip CRC/ISIZE or truncate trailer and recompute manifest.archive SHA/size so the negative does not merely hit the outer byte identity gate. Preserve actual RED/GREEN; if existing runtime already rejects a case, record real GREEN rather than fabricate RED.
gzip_crc_followup.conditional_fix: If real RED demonstrates missing full-stream validation, within transport use a streaming gzip reader through validated tar EOF then bounded drain to real gzip EOF/trailer. Bound total expanded tar bytes as well as payload bytes/member count, reject trailing/concatenated unexpected content, and retain every existing size/SHA/mode inventory check. No unbounded read() or claim that SHA validates CRC.
